# AI Use Statement

## Use of AI Assistance - Generated by ChatGPT

AI assistance was used during the development of this project to help explain Python concepts, troubleshoot errors, and improve the structure of the program.

## Work Completed by Me

I wrote and tested the main Python script used for the firewall analysis tool. This included loading the CSV file, working with pandas DataFrames, grouping firewall log data, creating summaries, printing results, and exporting the final reports to Excel files.

I also made decisions about the purpose of the tool, including using the program to support firewall traffic review and firewall rule planning.

## AI Assistance Used

AI was used to help explain how pandas works, including concepts such as DataFrames, `groupby()`, `agg()`, `unique()`, `nunique()`, and exporting data to Excel.

AI also helped suggest ways to improve the tool, including creating a second report that groups traffic by:

source_ip -> destination_ip -> destination_port
